title: A Gentle Lighting
narration: A smaller light warms the square while the group records what remains for tomorrow. Today's progress is useful and honestly celebrated.

dialogue.text: A gentle light and a clear next step are both worth sharing.

ending.headline: A Gentle Light
ending.summary: The lens was found and prepared safely. The village holds a smaller lighting while unfinished work waits without blame.

objectiveNotes.text: The missing lens was found at the boathouse.
The beacon was prepared safely for a limited lighting.
Neighbors who did not cross remain safe and can return later.

ending.reflection: Careful progress can be a meaningful success.
